title: Turmeric Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Drain, rinse, and dry the chickpeas thoroughly — dry chickpeas are what makes them crisp.
Toss with the olive oil, turmeric, cumin, black pepper, and sea salt.
Roast at 400F for 35 minutes, shaking the tray twice, until crunchy.
Cool completely before storing, or they turn soft.
goldenRuleCallouts: A crunchy snack built from a legume rather than a processed gluten-free packet.
Individual spices, not a blend, so there is no label to check.
storageNotes: Store loosely covered at room temperature and eat within 2 days. An airtight container traps steam and softens them, and the refrigerator softens them faster still.
